native_commands:
/bin/zsh -lc "python - <<'PY'
import subprocess
import sys
import click
from click.testing import CliRunner

@click.command()
def main():
    subprocess.run([\"python\", \"-c\", \"import sys; print('foo', file=sys.stderr)\"], stdout=sys.stderr, check=True)

result = CliRunner().invoke(main, [], catch_exceptions=False)
print(result.exit_code)
PY"
